description: Daily-driver energy board: house load, solar, grid, autarky, self-consumption. Drill to Solar Balkon or Power Consumption for raw phase/inverter data.

targets.query:
import "date"

grid = from(bucket: "waid-bucket")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 5m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "mqtt_consumer" and r["_field"] == "total_act_power")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

solar = from(bucket: "waid-bucket")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 5m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "solar" and r["_field"] == "power" and r.channel == "0")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

union(tables: [grid, solar])
  |> group()
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: v.timeRangeStop, _value: r._value}))

panels.title: Autarky today
panels.description: self-consumed solar / house load. How self-sufficient the apartment is today.

targets.query:
import "date"
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Zurich")

day_start = date.truncate(t: v.timeRangeStop, unit: 1d)

grid = from(bucket: "waid-bucket")
  |> range(start: day_start, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "mqtt_consumer" and r["_field"] == "total_act_power")
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "topic"])
  |> group(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])

import_wh = grid
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value > 0.0 then r._value else 0.0}))
  |> integral(unit: 1h)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._stop, _value: r._value, _field: "import_wh"}))

export_wh = grid
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: if r._value < 0.0 then -r._value else 0.0}))
  |> integral(unit: 1h)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._stop, _value: r._value, _field: "export_wh"}))

solar_wh = from(bucket: "waid-bucket")
  |> range(start: day_start, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "solar" and r["_field"] == "power" and r.channel == "0")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0.0)
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "channel", "serial", "topic"])
  |> group(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])
  |> integral(unit: 1h)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._stop, _value: r._value, _field: "solar_wh"}))

union(tables: [import_wh, export_wh, solar_wh])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value: if (r.import_wh + r.solar_wh - r.export_wh) > 0.0
        then (r.solar_wh - r.export_wh) / (r.import_wh + r.solar_wh - r.export_wh)
        else 0.0
    }))

panels.title: Load / Solar / Grid
panels.description: House load = grid + solar. Grid negative when exporting. Sun altitude on the right axis shows why solar starts and stops.

targets.query:
grid = from(bucket: "waid-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "mqtt_consumer" and r["_field"] == "total_act_power")
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "topic"])
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "grid"}))

solar = from(bucket: "waid-bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "solar" and r["_field"] == "power" and r.channel == "0")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "channel", "serial", "topic"])
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "solar"}))

union(tables: [grid, solar])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      Grid: r.grid,
      Solar: if exists r.solar then r.solar else 0.0,
      "House load": r.grid + (if exists r.solar then r.solar else 0.0)
    }))
  |> group()

panels.title: Daily energy (last 30 days)
panels.description: Solar yield and grid import/export per day from the downsampled archive. Grid import and export are gross (not net).

targets.query:
import "timezone"
import "date"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Zurich")

start = date.truncate(t: date.add(d: -30d, to: v.timeRangeStop), unit: 1d)
stop = date.truncate(t: date.add(d: 1d, to: v.timeRangeStop), unit: 1d)

solar = from(bucket: "waid-bucket-downsampled")
  |> range(start: start, stop: stop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "solar" and r["_field"] == "yieldday" and r.channel == "0")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false, location: location)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value / 1000.0, _field: "Solar yield"}))
  |> drop(columns: ["channel", "serial", "topic", "host"])

import_ = from(bucket: "waid-bucket-downsampled")
  |> range(start: start, stop: stop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "energy_daily" and r["_field"] == "grid_import_kwh")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Grid import"}))

export_ = from(bucket: "waid-bucket-downsampled")
  |> range(start: start, stop: stop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "energy_daily" and r["_field"] == "grid_export_kwh")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Grid export"}))

union(tables: [solar, import_, export_])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
